text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Dis... continued...?
This month's issue of Monthly Holy Knight... won't be coming out...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No way... I steadily gathered the bonus parts,
and the Holy Knight set was almost complete...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Only the holy sword remained to be drawn, and yet... !?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How should I say this...
I feel for you...

"That night, Durandal stared blankly
at the Holy Knight Set that would never be complete."
